data.content: For Algae: at events with sumTU > 1, how many substances typically contribute TU > 0.001 at that same site-year-quarter?

args.query: For the species algae (unicellular), consider all site–year–quarter events where sumTU > 1. For each such event, count the number of substances with TU > 0.001 at the same site–year–quarter. Return: (1) total number of such events, (2) summary stats of the per‑event counts (mean, median, 25th percentile, 75th percentile, min, max), and (3) a frequency table of the per‑event counts.
